title: 第一章 这个世界有点不对第二章 异界和平共处原则
content_zh:
进入六月，东海已经热的像个大火炉。
天空蔚蓝，看不到一朵云，炎炎烈日仿佛一颗巨大火球，高悬在天空之上。
东海一中。
下午五点半。
“铃铃铃……”
下课铃声一响，整个校园仿佛从沉睡中苏醒，顿时传出一片喧哗声。
片刻之后，大量学生从各栋教学楼中涌出，三五成群说笑着朝校门口走去。
“这天，太热了！”
有人咒骂道。
“王腾哥，晚上蔷薇酒吧喝酒去。”
一个声音将王腾从思绪中拉回现实。
“许杰！”
他看着来人，面孔熟悉，久远的记忆从脑海深处涌出，这是他高中时期圈子里的一个玩伴。
“你们玩吧，晚上我就不去了，有点头疼。”
王腾说道。
许杰急道：“别介啊，王腾哥，咱们这个小圈子本来就没几个人，你不来就没意思了，而且我们也有段时间没聚了，这样，换个时间，明天？后天？”
王腾摇了摇头，无奈道：“那就明天晚上吧。”
“好嘞，我通知小薇他们一声，明天晚上再聚。”
许杰高兴的笑道。
两人走到校门口，前面突然一阵骚动。

“咦，前面怎么回事？这么多人围着。”
许杰疑惑道。
“我去看看。”
说着他已经跑上去，挤开人群钻到了人群前面。
王腾双手插兜，慢悠悠的走过去，几个学生一看到他，纷纷让开道，生怕惹到他。
自己王大少的名头还真是够大！
王腾不由自嘲。
可惜并不是什么好名声。
他走到人群前边，看到空地上，一名女生将几个头发染的的黄黄绿绿的社会青年打趴在地，一个个哭爹喊娘，看着那女生的目光充满了惊惧。
再结合四周的议论，他大概了解到事情的经过。
刚刚放学，几个黄毛绿毛碰到了何曼容，见她长得漂亮，就忍不住上前调戏，说了几句污言秽语。
content_en:
Entering June, the East China Sea is already as hot as a big furnace.
The sky was blue, not a single cloud could be seen, and the scorching sun hung high in the sky like a huge fireball.
Donghai No. 1 Middle School.
Half past five in the afternoon.
"Ring ring ring..."
As soon as the bell rang for the end of get out of class, the whole campus seemed to wake up from a deep sleep, and there was a sudden uproar.
After a while, a large number of students poured out of each teaching building and walked towards the school gate in small groups chatting and laughing.
"It's so hot today!"
Someone cursed.
"Brother Wang Teng, let's go have a drink at the Rose Bar tonight."
A voice brought Wang Teng out of his thoughts and back to reality.
"Xu Jie!"
He looked at the person who came, the face was familiar, and long-lasting memories emerged from the depths of his mind. This was a playmate in his high school circle.
"You guys go ahead and play. I won't go there tonight. I have a bit of a headache."
Wang Teng said.
Xu Jie said anxiously: "Don't bother me, Brother Wang Teng, there are only a few people in our small circle. It would be boring if you didn't come, and we haven't gotten together for a while. So, let's change the time, tomorrow? The day after tomorrow?"
Wang Teng shook his head and said helplessly: "Then let's do it tomorrow night."
"Okay, I'll inform Xiaowei and the others and we'll meet again tomorrow night."
Xu Jie smiled happily.
When the two of them walked to the school gate, there was a sudden commotion in front of them.
"Hey, what's going on in front? There are so many people around."
Xu Jie said doubtfully.
"I'll go take a look."
As he said that, he ran up, squeezed through the crowd and got in front of the crowd.
Wang Teng put his hands in his pockets and walked slowly over. When several students saw him, they all moved out of the way for fear of offending him.
My own reputation as Young Master Wang is really big enough!
Wang Teng couldn't help but laugh at himself.
Unfortunately it doesn't have a good reputation.
He walked to the front of the crowd and saw a girl in the open space beating several social youths with dyed yellow and green hair to the ground. They were all crying for their fathers and mothers. The girl's eyes were filled with fear.
Combined with the discussions around him, he roughly understood what happened.
Just after school, several yellow-haired and green-haired girls met He Manrong. Seeing her beauty, they couldn't help but stepped forward to tease her and said a few dirty words.
